name: Superfire | 1.2g Infused Preroll | Fruit Ztripez
description:
Ignite your day with Superfire Infused Pre-Rolls. Infused with premium oil and natural terpenes that burn smooth and delicious through to the very end. Whether you’re chilling at home or hanging with friends, these pre-rolls bring the perfect mix of flavor and potency. Light up, relax, and enjoy the blaze

1.2g Pre-Roll - Premium Distillate and Natural Terpenes - 20 Strains

Fruit Ztripez: Savor the vibrant essence of Superfire’s Fruit Ztripez Infused Pre-Roll. Bursting with fruity flavors and infused with premium oil and natural terpenes, this hybrid strain offers a refreshing, uplifting experience that’s sure to brighten your day. Whether you're looking to socialize with friends or simply kick back and enjoy some time to yourself, Fruit Ztripez delivers a smooth, balanced high that enhances any occasion. Dive into the delicious world of Fruit Ztripez and let the good vibes roll!
